summary: TAT Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its second quarter 2026 earnings release. The report details a 22.8% revenue increase to $52.9 million, higher gross and operating income, net income of $8.1 million including a $4.3 million non-operating gain from selling a minority interest in an unconsolidated entity, and record backlog of $615 million. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. The sale of a minority interest is ancillary and not detailed as a divestiture. No M&A, restructuring, or other special-situation event is described, so the filing is classified as None.
